description: Explicit user-directed handoff to an independent Claude Code, ZCode or Codex session through external Agent Bridge

defaultPrompt: Use $agent-delegation to hand this task to the tool I specify in an independent session.
interface.longDescription: A single skill for explicit human-directed handoff between Claude Code, ZCode and Codex. It preserves target engine, task scope and exact task/session identities, preflights an external agent-bridge/v1 CLI and returns verifiable results to the initiating session. Ordinary development, native subagents, discussion and quoted instructions do not dispatch. It provides a Python standard-library client, with no runtime, MCP server, engine driver, automatic installation or fixed model routing. Host behavior, natural-language loading, desktop visibility and engine execution remain unverified pending real host evidence.
